how_to_record: A Gikuyu speaker records each prompt below as a short clip, saves it in this folder under the file name given, and sets recorded to true. When every clip is recorded, set placeholder to false. Do not machine-generate these clips and do not machine-translate the text: the meaning lines are the script to speak from.
why_phrase_locked: Gikuyu is limited to this fixed list of recorded phrases. Text or speech generated for it would not be checked by anyone on the team and could be wrong.
format: mp3 or m4a, mono, a few seconds each
